how to learn causal structure from data that has a much slower time-scale than the underlying dynamics.
the problem of inferring the causal structure of dynamical systems, where the measurement processes that provide the data occur at a much lower sampling rate than the dynamics of interest.
the problem of learning the structure of a causal system from data.
